char.coalition_whip.name: The Coalition Whip
char.foundation_director.name: The Foundation Director
card.sp_sponsor_withdrawal.text: The Foundation Director closes the budget folder. Two sponsors have withdrawn from your next tour. "They don't think being seen beside you buys them anything anymore. We can keep one—if the foundation's name appears on every stop."
card.sp_sponsor_withdrawal.left: Give the foundation top billing and save what remains.
card.sp_sponsor_withdrawal.right: Refuse the condition and replace the tour with smaller meetings.
card.sp_empty_press_room.text: Your Press Officer looks across rows of empty chairs. The networks sent no cameras. "We can pay for a satellite package and guaranteed distribution. Otherwise, this announcement happens to whoever is already in the building."
card.sp_empty_press_room.left: Buy national distribution and make the announcement visible.
card.sp_empty_press_room.right: Cancel the broadcast and speak to the local reporters who came.
card.sp_regional_coalition_invitation.te: The Coalition Whip puts six district names in front of you. "You have enough of a name to help us win them. Join our slate, and our organizers become yours. When the budget vote comes, we will remember the arrangement."
card.sp_regional_coalition_invitation.le: Join the coalition and accept the future vote commitment.
card.sp_regional_coalition_invitation.ri: Keep your organization independent, even if the coalition withdraws support.
card.sp_civic_foundation_partnership.tex: The Foundation Director offers to fund your district clinics. One agreement lists every donor and every expense. The other bundles the same donors behind a single foundation name—and raises four times as much before breakfast.
card.sp_civic_foundation_partnership.lef: Take the smaller, fully disclosed grant.
card.sp_civic_foundation_partnership.rig: Let the foundation bundle the donors privately.
card.sp_political_succession_request.tex: The Minister places a young relative's résumé on your desk. "They do not need a job. They need your endorsement. Your name turns a family ambition into a national succession plan."
card.sp_political_succession_request.lef: Refuse to turn your reputation into a family inheritance.
card.sp_political_succession_request.rig: Endorse the successor and bring the family network with them.
card.sp_private_capital_council.text: The Businessman slides over a membership card with no organization printed on it. "Everyone whose call moves a market is in the room. Your name is finally expensive enough to belong there. The first advisory payment clears tonight."
card.sp_private_capital_council.right: Join the council and accept the advisory payment.
card.sp_kingmaker.text: The Coalition Whip has the final vote count. No bloc can form a government without your name and your machinery. You can force every side into an open agreement—or promise the decisive endorsements privately, one donor at a time.
card.sp_kingmaker.left: Spend your power to broker a public coalition agreement.
card.sp_kingmaker.right: Sell the decisive endorsements through private channels.
card.sp_figurehead.text: The Coalition Whip is blunt. "Every camera follows you, but no committee chair follows an instruction. We can rebuild your vote operation from the districts up. It will cost money, and some of that shine. Or you can remain the face while others choose the policy."
card.sp_figurehead.left: Fund the district operation and rebuild real voting power.
card.sp_figurehead.right: Keep the spotlight and let the coalition run the machinery.
card.sp_feared_technocrat.text: The Foundation Director arrives alone. "Agencies obey you. Donors will not be photographed with you. Spend some of that authority on open grants and they may trust the process—or let your inspectors remind them what cooperation is worth."
card.sp_feared_technocrat.left: Give up control and create an open civic-grant board.
card.sp_feared_technocrat.right: Use regulatory pressure to secure the donations.
card.sp_marginal_officeholder.text: Your Aide has two folders left on an otherwise empty calendar. One contains twenty unresolved local cases that nobody important wants. The other contains requests from businesses willing to pay for small shortcuts your office can still provide.
card.sp_marginal_officeholder.left: Take the local cases and rebuild relevance one family at a time.
card.sp_marginal_officeholder.right: Sell the office as a private enforcement network and fill its empty posts with loyal operators.
card.act1_constituent_case_callback.left: Publish the full case and spend office power protecting every witness named in it.
card.act2_business_audit.left.powerful: Spend political capital to place the audit beyond your office—and his reach.
card.act2_hospital_funding.right.powerfu: Spend your authority to clear the queue without weakening the safety review.
card.act3_protected_contract.left.powerf: Use your authority to install an independent procurement firewall.
Divest, take the loss, and spend authority on an independent procurement firewall.
card.act3_authority_vote.left.powerful: Commit your whole bloc to an authority that even you cannot dismiss.
card.aftermath_records.left.powerful: Use what remains of your authority to preserve every record before anyone can interfere.
